summary: Unexpected 'Conditional Rate Floor Adjustment' line on finalized invoice after scheduled batch run
description:
Issue summary:
Customer Nimbus Analytics received an unexpected invoice line titled 'Conditional Rate Floor Adjustment' on invoice INV-2026-03-08-99 (finalized). The adjustment increased the billed amount for a scheduled nightly batch job that the customer believes should have been covered by an active promotional credit (promo code FREEBATCH-2026) and reserved hours.

Impact:
- Customer reports $1,250 one-off increase on finalized invoice.
- Affects month-end reconciliation for Nimbus (enterprise seat billing).
- Customer cannot reconcile the charge with console estimates and is asking for provisional credit while we investigate.

Environment:
- Prod (us-east-1)
- API key: ak_live_nimbus_01xxx (customer provided in ticket)
- Invoice: INV-2026-03-08-99
- Batch job IDs: batch-20260307-34A, batch-20260307-34B

Steps to reproduce (customer-provided):
1) Scheduled nightly batch (23:30 UTC) submitted via scheduling API using the customer API key.
2) Batch contains 12k embeddings and 120 tool invocations (metadata enrichment).
3) Console showed estimate 0.00 USD due to promo credit and reserved-hour overlay.
4) Final invoice shows a 'Conditional Rate Floor Adjustment' for 1,250.00 USD.

Logs / evidence attached by customer:
- Exported postback CSV for the batch window (2026-03-07T23:30:00Z - 2026-03-08T00:30:00Z)
- Screenshot of console estimate showing zero cost
- Copy of promo confirmation email for FREEBATCH-2026

Notes: Customer explicitly requests provisional credit to avoid failed payment for an unexpected finalized line and asks for timeline of the root cause and permanent fix.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:17 - Aisha Patel (Support): Initial triage - acknowledged receipt, requested postback CSV and invoice PDF. Escalated to billing team for provisional credit decision.

2026-03-10 11:02 - Nimbus (Customer: Priya Rao): Uploaded postback CSV, console screenshot, and promo confirmation. Says scheduled job always runs under the promo for March and had reserved capacity pinned.

2026-03-10 14:45 - Tomás Novák (Billing): Reviewed invoice lines. 'Conditional Rate Floor Adjustment' is emitted by pricing-engine when blended-rate evaluation falls below negotiated floor during multi-rate aggregation. Opening investigation with pricing-engine owners. Requested sample of raw event records for the time window (provided by customer).

2026-03-11 08:30 - Jordan Lee (SRE): Ran postback reconciliation for API key ak_live_nimbus_01xxx. Found 23 postbacks tagged as 'tool-invoke' and 11,967 as embeddings. Two postbacks from eu-west-1 proxies (fallbacks) were marked as hosted-fallback and did not carry the reserved-tag. Pricing-engine aggregated the window and applied a floor because of mixed-tier evaluation (hosted fallback + reserved), which appears to be over-triggering when promo credit is present.

2026-03-11 13:10 - Billing (Tomás Novák): Recommended provisional credit of full adjustment pending root-cause. Billing applied provisional credit request to account (internal memo ID BIL-PR-5741). Final adjustment will be confirmed after engineering patch.

2026-03-12 10:05 - Engineering (Priyanka Singh): Found pricing-engine rule that computes blended rate uses tag normalization that strips promo flags when hosted-fallback proxies are present. This causes the blended-rate to be evaluated without promo and compared to the contract floor, triggering the adjustment. Patch created to preserve promo tag precedence in the aggregator. PR linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pricing-engine/pull/842. Marked INT-213444 for rollout coordination and QA.
investigation_notes: Aggregate query: SELECT sum(tokens) FROM postbacks WHERE api_key='ak_live_nimbus_01xxx' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-07T23:30:00Z' AND '2026-03-08T00:30:00Z' -> embeddings=11967, tool-invokes=23, fallback-hosted-events=2
Observed two fallback postbacks from eu-west-1 (proxy-891) that lacked the reserved_hour_tag due to transient tag-stripping bug on proxy during cross-region failover.

Pricing logic: blended_rate = weighted_mean(per_event_rate); if blended_rate < contract_floor then apply 'Rate Floor Adjustment' = (contract_floor - blended_rate) * billed_units. Promo credits should have been applied before floor evaluation but were being ignored when fallback events present.
Root cause hypothesis: tag precedence bug in pricing-engine aggregator leads to promo flag being dropped when any postback in a window originates from hosted-fallback proxies.
resolution: Provisional credit of 1,250.00 USD applied to Nimbus Analytics account pending final invoice correction. Engineering patch to pricing-engine merged (PR #842) and scheduled for canary rollout to pricing-engine service on 2026-03-13. Internal follow-up ticket created INT-213444 for QA and post-deploy verification. Customer to be updated when fix is live and final invoice recalculated.
next_steps: 2026-03-13: Canary rollout of pricing-engine patch (Priyanka) - verify promo-tag precedence preserved in blended-rate evaluation.
2026-03-13 to 2026-03-14: Recompute reconciled invoices for any affected accounts during the same window and create final adjustments where appropriate (Billing).
Notify customer (Nimbus) with final invoice delta and confirmation of credit removal or retention.
